evidence.notes: Preserve lane: existing shadcn composition and Evil Charts area treatment retained; no dependency added. Product events now leads with named actions, action counts, sessions, and an event-only trend; page, source, and audience detail appears only after selecting an event. Web analytics retains traffic, acquisition, audience, and engagement. API monitoring and Logs are permanently visible under Backend and route to setup when disabled or empty. The app frame uses the shadcn inset sidebar, section-specific icon treatment, sticky scope controls, and responsive endpoint cards before the table becomes cramped. Root inspected both surfaces at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels in dark and light; no P0, P1, or P2 findings. The private app uses a dedicated 1.32 kB theme-stable HTML document, while the public 9.88 kB SEO document remains exclusive to the landing page. Local Cloudflare asset routing verified the exact app entry. Full pnpm run check passed with 120 browser scenarios; final capability copy also passed 59 App tests and web typecheck. No production measurement or deployment in this turn.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner identified Web analytics and Events as visually conflated and could not find the backend product. Product events and API monitoring are now distinct, visible surfaces. Implemented locally; no release requested for this turn.
